{{Quote|&hellip;to the ship...?|Unidentified blue Youngling|<ref name="YOUNG" />}}
An '''individual''' enrolled in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academyas]] an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] during the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="YOUNG" />

==Biography==
This individual was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Assigned to an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate Clan]], they were cautious, calm and followed orders. They were close friends with another [[Unidentified insectoid youngling|youngling]].<ref name="YOUNG" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the youngling and a group of fellow students, including [[Ammon]], [[Cryle]], [[Tryla (Jedi Initiate)|Tryla]], a [[Unidentified brown-haired youngling|Human Youngling]] and an Insectoid Youngling, accompanied [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a training [[Mission to unidentified planet (Younglings)|mission]] to a jungle [[Unidentified planet (Younglings)|planet]].<ref name="YOUNG" />
